newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.48 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.48 pct higher.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed up by 0.48 percent on Tuesday in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 511.85 from 509.39 on Monday.
Total volume was 1.38 million dinars against 721,750 dinars. Turnover on the first market was 867,628 dinars from 486,179 over the previous session.

Milk firm Tunisie Lait gained 1.38 dinars to 24.1 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia gained 0.7 dinar to 46.7. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing LEAS.TN was up 0.3 dinar to 33.3. Airliner Tunis Air rose 0.36 dinar to 22.36 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie advanced 0.48 dinar to 75.5 dinars. ATB bank was up 0.3 dinar to 34.52.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF fell 0.4 dinar to 20.8 dinars. BTEI bank declined 0.24 dinar to 23.66.
Cola and beer bottler SFBT slid 0.14 dinar to 95 dinars.
